title: Toy Dogs
subtitle: Bark and fight within the confines of these muddy walls. We owe you eulogies and laurels for your bravery.

items.text: Toy Dogs

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh ...! It really hurts! I got hit!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: My Lady! Stand behind me!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The piano keeps playing.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Urrgh ...!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The battle is intense. The number of the injured on both sides is still increasing ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We have assembled so many combatants ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But if that's the Manus's power, I will then need ... much more training ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: You are all bleeding.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Huh!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You are ...

items.speaker: X
items.text: Whoa, here comes a trickier guy?!

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Heh heh ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We're in trouble ...!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Everybody, keep 50 feet away from her!

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Vertin, my lovely puppet, art thou leaving?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Correct.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And one day ... I will be back and beat you personally.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Heh heh, how wonderful.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Lady Vertin ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thou lead them, from vanity to reality, from the past to the present.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thou seek the light, sacrifice thy body, conduct forth carrying sorrows.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Vertin, the saviour that people follow.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Blessings be unto you, whose people shall be no more in hours.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Mayst thou be in peace ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: When the rain falls into the sky.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: As always.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: As she raises her hand, black slime gathers and becomes the disciples.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Arise.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The disciples follow her order, walking towards Vertin.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Be gone.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The enemy is coming! Everybody protect yourselves!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Other members of Manus Vindictae run to Arcana. They fade in the rain.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: It's raining. Home we shall be.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: It's hard to understand her smile.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Leave no regrets in these final hours ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Goodbye.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... They ran away!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We can't relax yet. Defeat the shadows first! Please everybody hold on!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Finally ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Amazing! Amazing! We finally defeated the Manus scoundrels!

items.speaker: X
items.text: Oops, it's really thrilling! ... I don't think I'm good for the field work.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Those who are not injured, please take charge of the inventory, and gather all the refugees.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Whose people shall be no more ...?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There are ... six hours left ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the following time ... symptoms will get worse ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The influence scope of the Storm Syndrome will be further expanded ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: How shall we spend ... the last hours? And what can I do?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Let's hear everyone's wishes. How about that?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Schneider ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: My lord, you're actually lying here defenceless. ... Heh Heh.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: We, have been with you for a long time. No reward? No way ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Schneider, what are you doing!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't suddenly get so close to her!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, the supplies have been counted, and are being transported to the headquarters. The refugees are also being settled.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I just received the news that here is not the main target for the Manus.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This morning, Arcana led other members and robbed a large amount of supplies from Washington.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What is ... the next mission for us? The "Storm" ... it should be coming soon ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This time, I want to hear everyone's wishes.
TO BE CONTINUED…
